race.comment: Tricky finish. JUST LIKE GABY (11) resumes down in the weights and brings some fresh form against a few that have been taking turns. She looked talented early but didn't quite go on with it, albeit she was a nice winner first up last campaign giving away weight to a handy one. She gets in light here and should take beating. MOBY DICK (2) struggled up in grade here last time. He's back in his right grade but probably wants it heavy, watch conditions. NAVAL ACADEMY (3) hasn't really threatened this time in but is going okay and can figure in the finish. ALONG THE RIVER (1) shared the spoils here last time over 1000m at a big price. The query for him is 1100m - he's usually running on empty late. NIMBUSTWOTHOUSAND (4) is probably better suited to 1100m out of that race and should be fighting out the finish.
